## Time Budget Data from Two Farms

### Material

Two commercial farms, one in Sweden (Farm A) and one in The Netherlands (Farm B). Data collected on 15 newly introduced heifers from each farm. The data also contains records from first lactating cows that have been in the barn for 100 days.

## Functions

First I make some functions for computing 5-day means, standard deviations, and for plotting:

```{r}
filter_summarise <- function(cow.data, hours.threshold=16) {
  den = 1
  test = cow.data$hours<=1
  if (all(test)) den=24
  cow.data$budget[which(cow.data$hours < hours.threshold/den)]=NA
  cow.data$Period = 1
  cow.data$Period[cow.data$day>20 & cow.data$day <26]= NA
  cow.data$Period[cow.data$day>25]= 2
  df = cow.data %>%
    group_by(Area, Period) %>%
    summarize(avg_time_per_day=mean(budget, na.rm=TRUE), proportion_NA = sum(is.na(budget))/length(budget)) %>%
    na.omit()
  print(df)
  return(cow.data)
}

Overall_GAMLSS <- function(cow.data, farm) {
  results = list()
  kk=0
  for (AREA in c("Cubicle", "Feed", "Alley")) {
  df1 <- cow.data[cow.data$Area==AREA,]
  df10 <- na.omit(df1)
  if (farm=="Farm A") mod.group<-gamlss(budget~cs(day)*factor(ind)*factor(Period) + 
                                          random(factor(date)) +n_intro + hours + trimming, 
                                      sigma.fo=~day + n_intro  + hours + trimming, 
                                      data=df10, control=gamlss.control(trace=FALSE),
                                        method=mixed(20,20))
  if (farm=="Farm B") mod.group<-gamlss(budget~cs(day)*factor(ind)*factor(Period) + 
                                          random(factor(date)) +n_intro + hours + factor(ind), 
                                      sigma.fo=~day + n_intro  + hours, 
                                      data=df10, control=gamlss.control(trace=FALSE),
                                        method=mixed(20,20))
  model_summary <- capture.output(summary(mod.group))
  print("######################################")
  print(AREA)
  print("Estimates of nuisance parameters not shown")
  test1 <- substr(model_summary, 1,7) == "n_intro"
  test2 <- test1 + 1*(substr(model_summary, 1,5) == "hours")
  test3 <- test2 + 1*(substr(model_summary, 1,8) == "trimming")
  test4 <- test3 + 1*(substr(model_summary, 1,3) == "day")
  test5 <- test4 + 1*(substr(model_summary, 1,2) == "Mu")
  test6 <- test5 + 1*(substr(model_summary, 1,5) == "Sigma")
  test7 <- test6 + 1*(substr(model_summary, 1,7) == "(Interc")
  #for (i in 7:(length(model_summary)-13)) cat(model_summary[i],"\n")
  for (i in which(test7==1)) cat(model_summary[i],"\n")
  kk= kk+1
  results[[kk]] = mod.group
  }

  return(results)
}

plot_GAMLSS_Results <- function(Results_GAMLSS, Heifers, farm) {
  kk = 0
  for (AREA in c("Cubicle", "Feed", "Alley")) {
    df1 <- Heifers[Heifers$Area==AREA,]
    df10 = na.omit(df1)
    kk = kk + 1
    mod.group = Results_GAMLSS[[kk]]
    y.all = NULL
    for (IND in unique(df1$ind)) {
      df11 = df10[df10$ind==IND,]
      df11$n_intro=0
      df11$hours=24
      if (farm=="Farm A") df11$trimming=0
      df12 =na.omit(df11)
      df12$date = df12$date[1]
      y=predict(mod.group, what="mu", newdata=df12, data=df10)
      y.all <- c(y.all, y)
    }
    df.all <- cbind(na.omit(df1), y.all)
    p <- ggplot(df.all, aes(day, y.all)) +
      geom_point() +
      geom_point(x=df.all$day, y=df.all$budget ,
               color="red") +
      facet_wrap(~ind) +
      ggtitle(paste(farm, AREA)) +
      ylab("Proportion of day") + 
      ylim(0,1)
    print(p)
  }
}
 
get.5dMean <- function(cow.data, area="Cubicle", remove5=FALSE) {
  m <- numeric(9)
  cow.data = cow.data[cow.data$Area==area,]
  for (i in 1:9) m[i] <- mean(cow.data[cow.data$day %in% (i*5-4):(i*5),]$budget, na.rm =TRUE)
  if (remove5) m <- m[-5]
  return(m)
}

Get.SDs <- function(cow.data, area="Cubicle", days=c(1,20)) {
  n = length(unique(cow.data$ind))
  vec.days <- days[1]:days[2]
  vec.sd <- numeric(n)
  for (id in 1:n) {
    vec.sd[id] = sd(cow.data[cow.data$Area==area & cow.data$ind==id & cow.data$day %in% vec.days,]$budget, na.rm=TRUE)
  }
  return(vec.sd)
}

Get.SDs_residuals <- function(cow.data, area="Cubicle", days=c(1,20)) {
  n = length(unique(cow.data$ind))
  vec.days <- days[1]:days[2]
  vec.sd <- numeric(n)
  for (id in 1:n) {
    y = cow.data[cow.data$Area==area & cow.data$ind==id & cow.data$day %in% vec.days,]$budget
    x = cow.data[cow.data$Area==area & cow.data$ind==id & cow.data$day %in% vec.days,]$day
    df1 = data.frame(x=x, y=y)
    mod1 = gamlss(y~cs(x), sigma.fo=~1, data=na.omit(df1), control=gamlss.control(trace=FALSE))
    res1 = mod1$mu.fv - df1$y
    vec.sd[id] = sd(res1, na.rm=TRUE)
  }
  return(vec.sd)
}

violin_plots <- function(Heifers, CowDIM100, Area_use ) {
  SD.df = data.frame(SD=c(Get.SDs(Heifers, area=Area_use), Get.SDs(Heifers,days=c(26,45), area=Area_use), Get.SDs(CowDIM100, area=Area_use), Get.SDs(CowDIM100,days=c(25,45), area=Area_use) ),
                     Age=c(rep("Heifers", n1*2), rep("Older cows DIM>100", n2*2)),
                     Period=c(rep("Day 1-20", n1), rep("Day 26-45",n1),rep("Day 1-20", n2), rep("Day 26-45",n2))
  )
  rubrik=paste(Area_use,"Area")
  ggplot(SD.df, aes(x=Age,y=SD)) +
    geom_violin() +
    geom_violin(draw_quantiles = c(0.5)) +
    geom_point(alpha=0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~Period)+
    xlab("") +
    ylab("Standard deviations") +
    ggtitle(rubrik)
}

plot_smooth <- function(cow.data, AREA = "Cubicle", days=1:20, smooth.method="gam", main=NULL ) {
  df1 = cow.data[cow.data$Area==AREA,]
  df1 = df1[df1$day %in% days,]
  if (is.null(main)) main=paste("Days",days[1],"to",days[length(days)])
  ggplot(df1, aes(x=day, y=budget)) +
    geom_point() + 
    facet_wrap(~ind) + 
    geom_smooth(method=smooth.method) +
    ylab("Proportion of the day") +
    ggtitle(main)
}
```


### Farm A

First we analyze Farm A

```{r}
farm="Farm A"
#hours.threshold = 16
CowDIM100 <- read.csv(paste0(data.path,"CowDIM100Group1 (2).txt"), sep="")
CowDIM100 <- filter_summarise(CowDIM100)
Heifers<- read.csv(paste0(data.path,"BudgetData_w_hours_trimming.txt"), sep="")
Heifers <- filter_summarise(Heifers)
```

Make plots to get an overall picture per group (i.e. Heifers and older cows):

```{r, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| echo: false
df.5dMeans <- data.frame(FivedMeans=c(get.5dMean(Heifers, area="Cubicle"),
                                   get.5dMean(Heifers, area="Feed"),
                                   get.5dMean(Heifers, area="Alley"),
                                   get.5dMean(CowDIM100, area="Cubicle"),
                                   get.5dMean(CowDIM100, area="Feed"),
                                   get.5dMean(CowDIM100, area="Alley")
                                   ),
                         Age=c(rep("Heifers",9*3),rep("Older cows DIM>100",9*3)),
                         Days=rep(c("1-5","6-10","11-15","16-20","21-25","26-30", "31-35","36-40","41-45"),6),
                         Area=rep(rep(c("Cubicle", "Feed", "Alley"),2), each=9)
                         )
df.5dMeans$Days <- ordered(df.5dMeans$Days, levels = c("1-5","6-10","11-15","16-20","21-25","26-30", "31-35","36-40","41-45"))
ggplot(df.5dMeans,aes(x=Days, y=FivedMeans, group=Area, col=Area)) +
  geom_line(linewidth=1.5)+
  facet_wrap(~Age)+
  ylim(0,0.6)+
  ylab("Proportion of the day")+
  theme(legend.position="right")
```

*Overall GAMLSS modell*

```{r}
Results_GAMLSS =Overall_GAMLSS(Heifers, farm)
plot_GAMLSS_Results(Results_GAMLSS, Heifers, farm) 
```

*Violin plots*

Here we compute the variation of time spent in an area type between days (for a specified time period) for each individual separately and then plotting these as a violin plot:

```{r, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| echo: false
n1= length(Get.SDs(Heifers))
n2= length(Get.SDs(CowDIM100))

violin_plots <- function(Heifers, CowDIM100, Area_use ) {
  SD.df = data.frame(SD=c(Get.SDs(Heifers, area=Area_use), Get.SDs(Heifers,days=c(26,45), area=Area_use), Get.SDs(CowDIM100, area=Area_use), Get.SDs(CowDIM100,days=c(25,45), area=Area_use) ),
                     Age=c(rep("Heifers", n1*2), rep("Older cows DIM>100", n2*2)),
                     Period=c(rep("Day 1-20", n1), rep("Day 26-45",n1),rep("Day 1-20", n2), rep("Day 26-45",n2))
  )
  rubrik=paste(Area_use,"Area")
  ggplot(SD.df, aes(x=Age,y=SD)) +
    geom_violin() +
    geom_violin(draw_quantiles = c(0.5)) +
    geom_point(alpha=0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~Period)+
    xlab("") +
    ylab("Standard deviations") +
    ggtitle(rubrik)
}

p1 <- violin_plots(Heifers, CowDIM100, Area_use = "Cubicle" )
p2 <- violin_plots(Heifers, CowDIM100, Area_use = "Alley" )
p3 <- violin_plots(Heifers, CowDIM100, Area_use = "Feed" )
p1+p2 +p3 + plot_layout(ncol = 2) + plot_annotation(farm)
```

*Analysis and plots of standard deviations*

Here we analyze and plot the standard deviation of the raw data. We use log-transform to make it more normally distributed.

```{r, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| echo: false
for (AREA in c("Cubicle", "Alley", "Feed")) {
  x1 = log(Get.SDs(Heifers, area=AREA))
  y1 = log(Get.SDs(CowDIM100, area=AREA))
  x2=log(Get.SDs(Heifers,days=c(26,45), area=AREA))
  y2=log(Get.SDs(CowDIM100,days=c(26,45), area=AREA))
  cat("\n", AREA, "\n")
  cat("Difference Period 1: P-value= ")
  cat(round(t.test(x1,y1)$p.value,3),"\n") #P-value 0.06
  cat("Difference Period 2: P-value= ")
  cat(round(t.test(x2,y2)$p.value,3),"\n") #P-value 0.43
  cat("Difference between Period 1 and 2 for Heifers: P-value= ")
  cat(round(t.test(x1,x2, paired = TRUE)$p.value,3),"\n") #P-value 0.42
  p3 <- ggplot(data.frame(x=x1,y=x2), aes(x, y)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1) +
    xlab("logSD day 1 to 20") +
    ylab("logSD day 26 to 45") +
    ggtitle("Heifers")
  p4 <- ggplot(data.frame(x=y1,y=y2), aes(x, y)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1) +
    xlab("logSD day 1 to 20") +
    ylab("logSD day 26 to 45") +
    ggtitle("Older Cows")
  p.all <- p3+p4 + plot_layout(ncol = 2) + plot_annotation(paste(AREA, farm, "Comparison between periods"))
  print(p.all)
}
```

*SD of the residuals:*

```{r, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| echo: false
for (AREA in c("Cubicle", "Alley", "Feed")) {
  x1 = log(Get.SDs_residuals(Heifers, area=AREA))
  y1 = log(Get.SDs_residuals(CowDIM100, area=AREA))
  x2=log(Get.SDs_residuals(Heifers,days=c(26,45), area=AREA))
  y2=log(Get.SDs_residuals(CowDIM100,days=c(26,45), area=AREA))
  cat("\n", AREA, "\n")
  cat("Difference Period 1: P-value= ")
  Pval = round(t.test(x1,y1)$p.value,3)
  if (Pval==0) Pval = t.test(x1,y1)$p.value
  cat(Pval,"\n") #P-value 0.06
  cat("Difference Period 2: P-value= ")
  Pval = round(t.test(x2,y2)$p.value,3)
  if (Pval==0) Pval = t.test(x2,y2)$p.value
  cat(Pval,"\n") #P-value 0.43
  cat("Difference between Period 1 and 2 for Heifers: P-value= ")
  Pval = round(t.test(x1,x2, paired = TRUE)$p.value,3)
  if (Pval==0) Pval = t.test(x1,x2)$p.value
  cat(Pval,"\n") #P-value 0.42
  p3 <- ggplot(data.frame(x=x1,y=x2), aes(x, y)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1) +
    xlab("logSD day 1 to 20") +
    ylab("logSD day 26 to 45") +
    ggtitle("Heifers")
  p4 <- ggplot(data.frame(x=y1,y=y2), aes(x, y)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1) +
    xlab("logSD day 1 to 20") +
    ylab("logSD day 26 to 45") +
    ggtitle("Older Cows")
  p.all <- p3+p4 + plot_layout(ncol = 2) + plot_annotation(paste(AREA, farm, "Comparison between periods"))
  print(p.all)
}
```
